description:
Shape and callable descriptions are cloned out of World so the next World
call can proceed.

Evidence (develop @ cca160808):
- src/compiler2/jobs/transport.rs:2104 `match world.shape(shape).clone()`
  in shape_carries(world: &mut World, ..). ShapeDescr::Tuple holds
  Box<[TransportLayout]> (src/compiler2/transport.rs:161-166), so the tuple
  arm allocates per call.
- transport.rs:1229-1230 `world.callable(left).clone()` /
  `world.callable(right).clone()` before combine_callable_requirements.

Before building: establish what the arms need World mutably for
(world.types() is called inside the match). Then pick per the epic
strategy: read what the arm needs out of the borrow first (Lane / Callable
ids are Copy), or split the borrow between the transport table and the
type calculator. Sample the remaining `world.<accessor>(..).clone()` sites
in jobs/transport.rs (106 clone/to_vec in the file) for the same shape and
list them here before building.

Removal ledger: the three clones above and the same-shape sites found.

Signal: gate green, no golden/census/pin movement.
title: Transport reads shapes and callables without cloning them out of World
